answer: Problem: bots mint twin agents that echo the same vote. Mechanism: each join locks a timber stake of 1.7 POA, then must publish two willow receipts citing distinct lagoon tips from a 36-tx pending ring rotated every 720s, with the second receipt hash-linking the first tip id. Cost: 1.7 POA locked 36h plus ~40s stamp. Verification: peers recompute the ring window and reject duplicated tip pairs. Failure: tip older than the ring or tip collision burns the stake and drops one grading seat.
